primary_endpoint: annualized arithmetic mean of paired monthly net returns: v2 TREND minus matching v2 STATIC at 2 bps
secondary_endpoint: v2 TREND minus original baseline TREND at 2 bps

uncertainty.interpretation: Descriptive uncertainty at 36 months, not a powered confirmatory test; no automatic strategy promotion. Report both endpoints and both block lengths.

early_stopping: No performance-based early stopping or horizon extension. Data or accounting failures pause publication and are logged; never remove failed months or restart the clock to improve results.
activation_required: Timestamp the first evaluation month, data lineage, warmup availability, source schedule, initial flat state, runtime date overrides and this freeze hash before any evaluation-month outcomes are observed. Operational readiness is not yet established.
